title: Article 47 — Duty of the State to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health

content.overview: Article 47 directs the State to regard the raising of the level of nutrition and the standard of living of its people and the improvement of public health as among its primary duties, and, in particular, to endeavour to bring about prohibition of the consumption of intoxicating drinks and drugs injurious to health except for medicinal purposes.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Public health and nutrition policy; prohibition aspect is policy, not a private right of action. Related: Arts 21, 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this as a freestanding justiciable right.
